programme.title: E3 - The Opal Coast: Amidst Winds And Tides
programme.desc: Nestled in the Hauts-de-France region, the Opal Coast is a land with a distinct character, home to a diverse range of landscapes. Through their daily commitment, the local inhabitants- deeply attached to their roots- help safeguard their traditions and preserve their environment.

programme.title: E10 - Blenio Valley
programme.desc: We begin the day with a cheese tasting and a wildflower picking session in Orsaira, before an exciting treasure hunt in the pine forest of Ghirone. The hike continues along the old Sosto path, before finally reaching Olivone.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: A sailor is murdered aboard a Swiss merchant navy cargo ship docked in Cape Town, South Africa. Aurelie Mercier, from the criminal police, is sent to bring back the suspect, Florian. He claims he's innocent and says he's looking for Julia, his girlfriend who recently disappeared.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: Still detained in Cape Town, Florian tells Aurelie he joined the cargo ship because Julia was aboard before she vanished. The investigator decides to believe him and stays on board. The captain and crew are suspicious: they remain vague about Julia.

programme.title: E10 - Blenio Valley

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil S8
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Levy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: E11 - China In Quebec
programme.desc: Steven Wong is the third chef in his family to run the Wong restaurant in Quebec City. He introduces Helene to Chinese culture and teaches her how to cook the great classics.

programme.title: E5 - The Chablais, Land Of Four Winds
programme.desc: The green massif of Chablais spreads over the heights of Lake Geneva. Gusts from the water and the breath of the ridges shape the characters and destinies of the region's children. Encounters with those who maintain a unique relationship with the wind.

programme.title: E9 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: E35
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taipei. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky...
